content: Josẹph ọmaana kwanọng kwa Pọtipha
Mada iwa anọng p'Ishimayẹl akk'Josẹph atzima achina k'Ijip, wa Pọtipha kw'ode ọkhaan-nọng wani kwa Phero, obiro ode oho kw'anọng p'abaabh-ẹ, odebh Josẹph ka mbọhk anọng mba.
Mada Josẹph orukhi k'ọhọhm kw'itta kwẹ kw'ofon Ijip, wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi owobh ttar-ẹ, obiro osi idik ijibh inang-ẹ.
Mada itta kwẹ on-ore bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi owobh ttara Josẹph, obiro ore bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọnang-ẹ owujibha k'idik kpenamkpen s'osi,
wa Josẹph ọtzọkha ọphyaam k'itzitzikha sẹ, ọn-ọtzọkh-ẹ mach'ọtzọhmnọng kwẹ. Mẹ wọ, Pọtipha ọn-ọtzọkha ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'ọkhaam ọnang-ẹ bi, okkeri.

Ttẹwọr k'ogbe kw'iwa otte ẹhọhmmọr chẹ ọmaana ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'ọkhaam ọbọhk ọnang Josẹph bi okkeri, wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oreng Josẹph abẹ odo ẹhọhmmọr ch'Ojipnọng nwa. Wa ẹdaa ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi en-ewobh k'ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'ọkhaam k'ọhọhm ttara k'iwoni sẹ.

Mẹ wọ, odik kw'iwa obiro ọkpakha Pọtipha oyongi ọchattọhk f'ochi kode, da okk'idik biphyir s'ọkhaam ọbọhk ọtta ọnang Josẹph bi, okkeri. Wa Josẹph ojibhi odikkobh obiro ode ọnọng kw'ofhu ka for bi gbuk.
Okwu opyiri k'ogbe mẹ, kwanọng kw'itta kwẹ om-otzini chen okkeri Josẹph adadaakha-chen, oben-ẹ bi, “Kwu yim-m abẹ.”
Yina, Josẹph obhum, oben kwanọng nwa bi, “Itta kwaam okk'idik sẹ s'ọkhaam biphyir ọbọhk ọtta ọnang-m bi, nkkeri. Odik manda wani kw'obiro ọkpakh-ẹ dọk kode.

M'ọhọhm nwa, ọnọng ọdọdọk kw'ọkhaam ẹfa ọyọhnga kaam kode. Odik manda wani kw'itta kwaam obiro ọram-m, kw'oyongi kọ kw'ade kwanọng kwẹ, kode. Kaam nna nnenga yan nsi itzama, ttara ọkhọngkwuri-dik-dema nwa, mpyibh k'itzitzikha s'Ibinọkpaabyi o?”
Chibhi da kwanọng nwa ọyakhi Josẹph atzim k'ewu kpenamkpen bi, oyim-ẹ abẹ, Josẹph kokher.
Wa ewu dani, Josẹph ọtza odim k'ọhọhm bi, otza osi itzọhmbọhk sẹ, k'ogbe kw'ọtzọhmnọng ọdọdọk manda wani oni k'ọhọhm ode.
Kwanọng nwa ọbọkha Josẹph k'ittọhk-kwuma s'ọpaabh k'erin, ọben bi, “Kwu yim-m abẹ!” Yina, Josẹph otte ittọhk-kwuma sẹ ọbọhk ọnang-ẹ, ọrọbh oyin k'iyaan.
Mada kwanọng nwa ore bi, ọkk'ọrọbha ọjẹ-ẹ ittọhk-kwuma sẹ ka mbọhk sẹ oyin k'iyaan,

on-oyeri atzọhmnọng pẹ p'ọhọhm, oben bẹ bi, “Bọng akk'ara, odim kwaam otzim oHiburu-nọng nwa okwu ma bi, okwu ọnang man che-tzama! Odimi okhebh-m k'ọhọhm bi, okwu oyim-m abẹ, yina, kaam nna mkpẹbhi ẹmọng k'ẹrọng e.
Mada ọbhaang ẹmọng cha mkpẹbhi nnor ẹkkaana, mẹ kw'ọn-ọrọbhi oji ittọhk-kwuma sẹ ma oyin k'iyaan e.”
Ọn-ọtzọkha ittọhk-kwuma nna ohok maa, itta kwa Josẹph okhuna.
Mẹ wọ, ọtzọkha odik nwa ọgbaakh-ẹ bi, “Obira nwa kw'ode oHiburu-nọng, kw'atzim achena man ma, odimi okhebh-m k'ọhọhm bi, okwu oyim-m abẹ ọnang-m che-tzama.
Mada ọn-ọbhaang ẹmọng cha kaam mkpẹbhi nnor ẹkkaana, ọn-ọrọbh oyin k'iyaan oji ittọhk-kwuma sẹ ma ttar-m.”
Mada itta kwa Josẹph ọbhaang odik kwa kwanọng kwẹ ọgbaakh-ẹ, oben bi, “Manda wọ kw'obira kwọ osi-m e”, ettem ẹdọkh-ẹ k'idendama.
Mẹ wọ, itta kwa Josẹph, ọbọkha Josẹph ọtzọhm mgbakkọhbh, k'ibe sa bẹ agbakhi agbakkọkkọhbha p'ọvaarnọng. Wa bẹ ahokh-ẹ kẹ. Yina, mada Josẹph owobh ka mgbakkọhbh,
wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi owobh ttara Josẹph, osi ejibha ọnang-ẹ, obiro ọsẹ-ẹ ọtzọkha ọphyaam k'itzitzikha s'oho kw'akker-agbakkọkkọhbha.
Mẹ wọ, oho nwa kw'akker-agbakkọkkọhbha ọtzọkha Josẹph osi oho kw'agbakkọkkọhbha biphyir, obiro ọnang-ẹ ẹfa ch'odik kpenamkpen k'ọgbakkọbh-họhm.
Wa oho kw'akker-agbakkọkkọhbha ọn-ọrọbha mbọhk sẹ k'odik kpenamkpen kw'oyim ọnang Josẹph bi okkeri, okhuri da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi owobh ttara Josẹph, obiro ọnang-ẹ owujibha k'odik kpenamkpen kw'osi.
